hunt.justification: Automated triage pipelines execute untrusted researcher code. A negative result confirms that sandbox and proxy controls are effectively containing this execution.

meta.analysis: This hunt pivots from host inventory to untrusted process behavior and network prevalence. A single rule would struggle with the 'expected' noise of a reproduction script; the hunt uses the 'tester' container context and rarity to weigh maliciousness.

coverage.reason: Initial report ingestion is handled by existing platform monitoring.

scenario.summary: An automated AI triage system for bug bounty reports processes submissions through an eight-stage analysis pipeline and an ephemeral sandbox reproduction phase. The system utilizes ephemeral GCP virtual machines and Docker containers to execute researcher-provided reproduction scripts while enforcing 30-minute self-destruction and network egress filtering through a proxy.

meta.rationale: The hunt should be restricted to the GCP project and VM families (e2-standard) used for the bug bounty triage pipeline.
meta.hypothesis: An attacker has escaped the reproduction sandbox during automated triage or is abusing the ephemeral VM's egress to tunnel C2 traffic.

config.content: SELECT hostname, hardware_model, cloud_instance_id, first_seen, last_seen FROM hb_devices WHERE provider = 'gcp' AND (hardware_model = 'e2-standard-2' OR hardware_model = 'e2-standard-4') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Locate the GCP VMs matching the e2-standard profile used for AI triage and reproduction.
config.expected_signal: Hostnames corresponding to the 30-minute ephemeral VMs. Silence indicates no triage activity.

primitive_config.label: Identify ephemeral triage sandboxes
primitive_config.content: SELECT hostname, hardware_model, cloud_instance_id, first_seen, last_seen FROM hb_devices WHERE provider = 'gcp' AND (hardware_model = 'e2-standard-2' OR hardware_model = 'e2-standard-4') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Hostnames corresponding to the 30-minute ephemeral VMs. Silence indicates no triage activity.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%tester%' OR LOWER(process_path) NOT LIKE '/usr/bin/docker%') AND LOWER(user_name) != 'root' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify processes on the host that are not part of the standard Docker daemon or orchestrator.
config.expected_signal: Execution of shell/python scripts outside the container context. Silence suggests effective isolation.

primitive_config.label: Detect escape or host-level execution
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%tester%' OR LOWER(process_path) NOT LIKE '/usr/bin/docker%') AND LOWER(user_name) != 'root' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Execution of shell/python scripts outside the container context. Silence suggests effective isolation.

nodes.label: Rare network egress from triage VMs

config.content: SELECT dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) as host_count, MIN(time) as first_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND direction = 'outbound' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port HAVING host_count <= 2 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Find connections to unique IPs that indicate report-specific C2 or non-standard ports.
config.expected_signal: Outbound IPs seen from very few sandboxes.

primitive_config.label: Rare network egress from triage VMs
primitive_config.content: SELECT dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) as host_count, MIN(time) as first_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND direction = 'outbound' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port HAVING host_count <= 2 ORDER BY host_count ASC
primitive_config.expected: Outbound IPs seen from very few sandboxes.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND instr(',' || '{{whitelist_patterns}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
